name: World Clock
description: Your cities at a glance with day and night icons, a slider to shift the time, and a planner that finds hours that work for everyone.
prompt: A world clock: add cities from a list, see their time, day and difference from mine with a sun or moon icon, a slider to move the time forward or back, and a meeting planner grid that highlights the hours that are working hours everywhere.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Tus ciudades de un vistazo con iconos de día y noche, un deslizador para mover la hora y un planificador que encuentra horas que van bien a todos.
